pick.headline: IRA bomb kills eleven at Enniskillen Remembrance service
pick.summary: On November 8, 1987, an IRA bomb exploded at a Remembrance Day ceremony in Enniskillen, Northern Ireland, killing eleven people.
pick.significance: The attack on civilians at a memorial caused revulsion across Ireland and Britain and damaged the IRA politically.
pick.fbis: TASS's Russian-language international service reported from London on November 8 a powerful explosion at the war memorial in Enniskillen, citing the Press Association on at least ten dead.

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Soviet Union, No. 216, 09 November 1987
evidence.snippet: …land Bombing Reported LDO90117 Moscow TASS International Service in Russian 1248 GMT 8 Nov 87 [Text] London, 8 Nov (TASS)}—There was a powerful explosion today at the war memorial complex in the Northern Ireland town of Enniskillen. Large squads of police, firemen and ambulances arrived at the scene According to a police spokesman, there are many casu- alties among the visitors to the complex According to the Press Association, at least 10 people…
